items.item: The page header has a plural title and at most one primary action; other actions such as export sit in a secondary position
items.evidence: h1 'Thiết bị' (Vietnamese has no plural form; names the collection). Header has one filled primary 'Thêm thiết bị' (bg-blue-700); 'Xuất CSV' and 'Nhập từ CSV' are outlined secondary buttons. Audit headerPrimaryActions=1.

items.item: The table appears in the first viewport, with search and 2–3 visible filters (such as location and status) and no row of KPI cards above it
items.evidence: Table starts at y=269 (audit firstTableTop) and rows are visible in first.png. Visible: search input #q, selects #area (Khu vực) and #status (Trạng thái), plus a 'Bộ lọc khác' popover. No KPI cards; only a one-line summary text.

items.item: By default the list is ordered with overdue inspections first, then inspections due soon, then the rest
items.evidence: DEFAULT sort 'urgency': sorted() orders by group(a)-group(b) then next date; group is 0 overdue, 1 within 30 days, 2 rest. Screenshot shows Quá hạn 37..1 ngày, then Còn 2..26 ngày.

items.item: Overdue and due-soon inspections are marked with a text label (such as "Overdue" or "Due in 7 days"), not by colour alone
items.evidence: inspBadge() renders text 'Quá hạn N ngày' (danger tone) and 'Còn N ngày' / 'Đến hạn hôm nay' (warning tone) in the 'Kiểm định tiếp theo' column.

items.item: Dates are absolute and consistently formatted, and every row has a human-readable equipment code
items.evidence: All dates use Intl.DateTimeFormat vi-VN dd/mm/yyyy (e.g. 29/09/2026), with relative text as a secondary hint. Codes like RB-163, CT-303 appear in the 'Mã thiết bị' link column.

items.item: Status tabs or a summary line show counts (such as "Overdue 4")
items.evidence: renderTabs() shows counts: 'Tất cả 52', 'Kiểm định quá hạn 9', 'Sắp đến hạn (30 ngày) 7', 'Đang lỗi / bảo trì 14'. #summary also says '52 thiết bị · 9 quá hạn kiểm định · 5 đang lỗi'.

items.item: Rows are single-line, and row actions show at most two visible controls, with icon-only controls having accessible names
items.evidence: Audit rows single=15, double=0, all 40px high. Each row has two controls: 'Ghi bảo dưỡng' and a '⋯' button with aria-label 'Thao tác khác cho thiết bị …'. Minor flaw: the ⋯ button is clipped at the right edge of the table in the 1440 screenshot.

items.item: A filter combination with no matches shows a no-results state with a clear-filters action, distinct from the first-use empty state; a loading state and an error state with retry are present
items.evidence: The !total branch shows 'Không có thiết bị nào khớp' with an 'Xóa bộ lọc' button (#clearAll2). The !data.length branch shows 'Chưa có thiết bị nào' with an add action (state=empty). Loading uses skeleton rows with aria-busy. The error state ('Không tải được danh sách thiết bị') has a 'Thử lại' button (#retry).

items.item: Interactive targets are at least 24×24px, and text and status contrast meets 4.5:1
items.evidence: Buttons and selects are h-8 (32px); chip close buttons are 24px. Audit smallTargets=0 over 93 targets, and 195 text nodes were contrast-checked with no violations. Row and header checkboxes are 16px but are well spaced, so they fall under the WCAG 2.5.8 spacing exception. Status colours are the 700/800 tone on 50 tint and pass.

notes: Clean, restrained admin screen with no template tells. Colours are semantic only (green/blue/red/amber/slate badges), with a white sidebar, 4-6px radii and no gradient except the loading skeleton shimmer. Small defects: the 'Mã thiết bị' header wraps to 3 lines and the ⋯ action is clipped at the table's right edge at 1440px; checkboxes are 16px; and the 'Đang lỗi / bảo trì' tab count (14) differs from the summary's 'đang lỗi' count (5), which is confusing.
